programmes.d: Rayna is upset when her record company asks her to tour as the opening act for a popular newcomer; Rayna's father, Lamar, disregards her wishes when he backs her husband in a run for mayor of Nashville.
Outraged to discover that Ephram and Madison have gotten romantically involved, Dr. Brown almost terminates her job. However, Madison quits, leaving the Browns with an unhappy holiday.
Within an hour of the discovery that Amy has run away from home, the authorities are at the Abbott house to scour for clues and interview her devastated parents and brother.
Dr. Brown tries to intervene when a bulimic high school champion wrestler puts his life in jeopardy. Bright is suspended from school after he fights with Amy's boyfriend, Tommy.
Distracted by her first fight with Tommy, Amy forgets to prepare her father's birthday dinner. Madison lies to Ephram about liking a love song he wrote, leading to an argument.
Ephram gets the wrong idea when Madison tells him her roommate is going to be out of town. Meanwhile, Amy decides she's ready to have sex with Tommy.
Ephram is horrified and heartbroken after he tells Madison that he loves her, and she doesn't reciprocate. Meanwhile, Linda naïvely agrees to take care of Delia overnight.
Bright helps Ephram get a fake ID so he can get into a bar to see Madison perform. Meanwhile, Nina relies on Dr. Brown for emotional support after she is served with divorce papers.
Amy moves back home but finds adjusting to her old life difficult. Meanwhile, Ephram thinks Madison is going to break up with him. And Dr. Brown testifies on behalf of Nina.
Against Dr. Brown's judgment, Ephram and Madison decide that she should resume her job as Delia's babysitter. Meanwhile, Amy contemplates stopping her antidepressant medication.
Amy tells Bright that she may have developed feelings for Ephram. When Linda's HIV status is accidentally revealed to her patients, Dr. Abbott faces a potential malpractice suit.
Ephram and Amy go to the prom together as friends, but after seeing Madison, Amy realizes that Ephram's still brokenhearted and decides not to reveal her feelings for him.
When Amy accompanies Ephram to Boulder, a romantic moment leads her to confess her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown tries to convince his mentor to undergo a riskier surgery.
Ephram is accepted into Juilliard's summer program, and Dr. Abbott decides to open a bagel shop after losing his malpractice insurance. Dr. Brown has a revelation about his family.
Ephram returns home from a summer program at the Juilliard School of Music, brimming with happy memories. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown copes with his new partnership with Dr. Abbott.
At her father's suggestion, Amy is determined to make the most of her senior year in the wake of Ephram returning from New York and telling her that piano has to be his priority.
Ephram regrets promising Nina that he would watch over Hannah at school. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown tries to ignore the tension between Dr. Abbott and Edna.
Andy is uncertain about what to do when Delia naïvely stumbles upon Nina's sex toy and starts asking questions. Meanwhile, Ephram attempts to write Amy a love letter.
Dr. Brown is embarrassed after he picks a fight with Everwood's "patron saint," Amanda Hayes, who has been caring for her profoundly disabled husband for the past five years.
